Outstanding Breakfast with Breathtaking Views!
Aug 2024 • Solo
I had an unforgettable breakfast at 3 Spoons Restaurant during my stay at InterContinental Hanoi Landmark72. The first thing that impressed me was the panoramic view of Hanoi from the 62nd floor — a perfect setting to start the day.

The buffet spread was exceptional, offering a rich variety of Asian and Western dishes. From freshly baked pastries and made-to-order eggs to traditional Vietnamese pho, sushi, and even Korean options — everything was top quality and beautifully presented.

Staff were incredibly polite and attentive, always ready to assist with a warm smile. The live cooking stations added a nice interactive touch, and I appreciated how clean and well-maintained everything was.

Highly recommend trying the local Vietnamese coffee with condensed milk — rich, smooth, and delicious!

A truly premium breakfast experience — perfect for both business travelers and tourists. I will definitely return!

Rather, try other restaurants on the 1st to 5th floors of the building.
Sep 2024 • Business
Restaurant food that was different from the pictures and descriptions on the menu: I had dinner at 3 Spoons restaurant several times. The ingredients in the food that actually came out were quite different from the pictures on the menu. The picture was pasta with lots of seafood, but there was only a little bit of it, or the description said it was a deep-fried fish dish, but only the skin was fried, and the meat was no different from a steamed dish. And there was even a hair in the salad at the breakfast buffet.

Insider tip:
Instead, try other restaurants on the 1st to 5th floors of the building. The food quality and taste are better there.
